name: Building Complaint Disposition Codes
description:
This dataset is a reference table mapping 160 disposition codes to their plain-language descriptions for building complaints, likely drawn from a municipal housing or buildings agency's complaint-handling system. Each row pairs a short code (such as A2, A6, or EA) with the outcome or status it represents, for example "CRIMINAL COURT SUMMONS SERVED," "ECB VIOLATION SERVED," or "COMPLAINT ACCEPTED BY PADLOCK UNIT." The table is nearly complete, with no missing values in either column, though one code appears to share a description with another.

The data is most useful as a lookup or decoding table: anyone working with raw complaint records can join on the code to retrieve a readable disposition, making reports and dashboards easier to interpret. It can also support building case-management or inspection systems that need standardized outcome labels, and it enables analysis of how building complaints are resolved—for instance, tallying how often violations are issued, cases go
